title: Aoki Denshō Welsh & Shedar Anime's Main Trailer Reveals More Cast Members, Theme Song Artists
content: The official website for Aoki Denshō Welsh & Shedar (The Azure Legend: Welsh & Shedar ), the original television anime by French entertainment company Ankama , revealed the anime's main promotional video, new cast members, and theme song artists on Thursday.
author: ANN

title: 'Phantom Busters' TV Anime Announced For 2027
content: A television anime adaptation of Shoco 's Phantom Busters manga was announced on Thursday through the anime's official website, revealing a commemorative illustration from Shoco (pictured to the right).
author: MyAnimeList

title: 'Hyouken no Majutsushi ga Sekai wo Suberu II' Announces Additional Cast Pair
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Nana Mikoshiba 's Hyouken no Majutsushi ga Sekai wo Suberu ( The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World ) light novel announced an additional pair of cast for its second season on Thursday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Neoshoco's Phantom Busters Manga Gets TV Anime in 2027
content: A website opened on Thursday to announce that Neoshoco 's Phantom Busters manga is getting a television anime adaptation that will air in 2027. Neoshoco drew an illustration to commemorate the news. Why bother fighting spectral foes like all the other exorcists when you can just eat them?
author: ANN

title: Phantom Busters Anime Adaptation Announced for 2027
content: Neoshoco’s Phantom Busters manga is officially getting a TV anime adaptation in 2027, as announced by the official X account on September 24. The announcement was previously teased with a graphic and the scheduled time, which was set for 18:00 JST. Neoshoco commented: “The anime adaptation is happening, yay!
author: Anime Corner

title: Star Detective Precure! Film Opens at #3, Cosmic Princess Kaguya! Returns at #6 in Japan
content: Eiga Chiikawa: Ningyo no Shima no Himitsu ( Chiikawa the Movie: The Secret of Mermaid Island), the first anime film adaptation of Nagano 's Chiikawa manga, stayed at #1 in its ninth weekend in Japan's box office from Friday to Sunday.
author: ANN

title: Idol Group WEST. to Cease Activities on September 30
content: The company previously announced on August 30 that members Ryusei Fujii and Nozomu Kotaki will be leaving the group. The company has had numerous discussions with the remaining five members ( Daiki Shigeoka , Akito Kiriyama , Junta Nakama , Tomohiro Kamiyama, and Takahiro Hamada) regarding the group's future…
author: ANN

title: Haganai: I Don't Have Many Friends Author Yomi Hirasaka Retires
content: Hirasaka was responding to a social media post that speculated that he was retiring for his mental health, after the negative feedback to A Salad Bowl of Eccentrics anime and the original light novel series' final volume. Hirasaka replied that both the anime and the final novel volume were extremely popular.
author: ANN

title: Gelpiyo Anime Gets Sequel on October 21
content: Tokyo MX announced on Thursday that the Gelpiyo television anime of industrial company Taica 's Gelpiyo mascot character will get a sequel that will premiere on the Tokyo MX1 channel on October 21. The regular cast members from the previous anime return to their roles.
author: ANN

title: Amata Games Unveils Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney – Dual Destinies VR Game for 2027
content: Amata Games announced on Thursday that it is developing an officially licensed version of CAPCOM 's Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney – Dual Destinies game for the Meta Quest virtual realty (VR) headsets and newly announced Meta VR Glasses headwear.
author: ANN
